deadline.value: Applications for research degrees are accepted on a rolling basis; applicants seeking funding must check specific funding application deadlines which may be earlier than course deadlines.
deadline.quote: Closing Dates | There is no application closing date for this course, but specific deadlines for funding may apply.

entry_route.value: A 2:1 honours degree (or international equivalent) in a relevant subject; combinations of undergraduate, master's, and relevant work experience are considered.
entry_route.quote: Typical entry requirements | 2:1 Honours degree | Academic entry requirements | A 2:1 Honours degree, or international equivalent, in a relevant subject. However, combinations of the following can be taken into consideration: undergraduate qualifications masters qualifications relevant work experience

supervisor.value: Postgraduate researchers engage in independent research under the guidance of experienced academic supervisors.
supervisor.quote: As a postgraduate research student at Newcastle, you’ll engage in independent research under the guidance of experienced supervisors, and with the support of our Doctoral College.

funding.value: Postgraduate research funding is competitive via university studentships, Doctoral Training Centres and Partnerships, and external research councils.
funding.quote: We invest in research funding to support our postgraduate research students. There are many options and opportunities for you to explore.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Mechanical and Systems Engineering MPhil, PhD) in the School of Engineering at Newcastle University; covers biomedical engineering research via the Centre for Biomedical Engineering.
